battle.name: 高梁河之戰
battle.brief: 太平興國四年七月，宋太宗趙光義乘滅北漢之勢北伐燕雲，圍幽州城逾月不下；遼將耶律休哥馳至，與耶律斜軫合軍分左右翼猛攻，幽州守軍開城列陣，宋軍三面受敵潰敗，太宗負箭乘驢車南走。戰地即今北京西直門外高梁河畔。卡面羅馬扭力弩砲是配重投石機的祖型，其蓄能之法正是宋軍弓弩之源頭。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 高梁河之戰是北宋太平興國四年北伐燕雲與契丹（遼）軍在幽州城下的決戰，參戰方為北宋與遼。宋方由皇帝趙光義御駕親征，兵力以禁軍為骨幹：殿前司諸班、侍衛司馬步軍等京營禁軍約十萬，另有駐邊禁軍與河南、河北兵儲約十萬，合計二十萬，有記錄作集結大軍三十萬。指揮系統上，太宗自居中樞，樞密使曹彬奉命調發各地屯兵，殿前司都虞候崔翰率先進言促成北伐；前線分面督攻城，宣徽南院使潘美、彰信軍節度使劉遇、定武軍節度使孟元喆、河陽三城節度使崔彥進各守一面，桂州觀察使曹翰與洮州觀察使米信屯城東南隅。遼方以幽州（南京）為核心，權留守韓德讓、知三司事劉弘與御盞郎君耶律學古同守城垣，南院大王耶律斜軫屯兵清沙河北岸德勝口，遠遠聲援而不敢南下；待宋軍圍城既久，遼景宗耶律賢才遣南府宰相耶律沙與北院大王耶律休哥率五院軍等入援，休哥所部約三萬，斜軫部萬餘，幽州守軍六、七萬。宋軍兵力遠多於遼軍援兵，卻因遠距離奔襲、久圍不克而陷入疲態，士氣亦隨封賞未兌現而低沉。
countriesEn: The Battle of Gaoliang River was the decisive engagement of the Northern Song campaign against the Khitan state of Liao in front of Youzhou in the fourth year of the Taiping Xingguo era, the belligerents being the Northern Song and the Liao. On the Song side the emperor himself, Zhao Guangyi, led the expedition in person. Its strength was built on the imperial guards: about 100,000 men of the capital garrison, such as the picked companies of the Palace Command and the foot and horse troops of the Guard Command, together with roughly 100,000 frontier guards and troops and stores from Henan and Hebei, making some 200,000 men in the field; one record puts the assembled force at 300,000. The command structure placed the emperor at the centre, with the military affairs commissioner Cao Bin ordered to mobilise the garrisons of the various circuits, and the Palace Command deputy commander Cui Han the first to speak openly in favour of the campaign. At the front the siege was divided face by face around the walls: the Vice Commissioner of the Court for Ceremonial and Military Affairs Pan Mei, the Military Governor of Zhangxin Army Liu Yu, the Military Governor of Dingwu Army Meng Yuanzhe and the Military Governor of Heyang Three Cities Cui Yanjin each took charge of one side, while the Observer of Guizhou Cao Han and the Observer of Taozhou Mi Xin held the southeast corner. On the Liao side the centre was Youzhou, the Southern Capital, defended by the acting keeper Han Derang, the commissioner of the Three Fiscal Offices Liu Hong and the Master of the Imperial Guard Yelü Xuegu; the Vice King of the Southern Court Yelü Xiazhen sat at Deshengkou on the north bank of the Qingsha River, reinforcing the city by reputation but not daring to march south. Only after the Song had besieged the city for a long time did the Liao emperor Yelü Xian send the chancellor of the Southern Administration Yelü Sha and the King of the Northern Court Yelü Xiuge with the Five Guards and other troops to relieve it: some 30,000 men under Xiuge, more than 10,000 under Xiazhen, and 60,000 to 70,000 in the city garrison. The Song fielded far more men than the Liao relief force, yet it was worn out by the long march and by a siege that produced nothing, and its morale sagged because the rewards promised after the conquest of the Northern Han had never been paid.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩營。宋方居中的是宋太宗趙光義，他剛於太平興國四年五月平定北漢，未及整軍便乘勝北伐；事前只有端州團練使、殿前司都虞候崔翰公開贊同，樞密使曹彬隨即奉命調兵。曹翰在城東南隅駐軍時，士卒掘土得蟹，他說蟹是水物而陸居，且多足，敵援將至，又說蟹即解，其班師乎，是全軍敗象最早的預警。馬步軍都軍頭趙延溥在隨軍不至時進諫，止住太宗以軍法處斬，保存了主力。傅潛與孔守正先期接戰沙河，擊潰遼北院大王耶律希達、統軍使蕭托古與伊實王薩哈所部，生擒五百餘人。遼方最關鍵者是北院大王耶律休哥，他自請赴援、以五院軍先行，受創三處仍力戰，創甚不能騎，改用輕車追至涿州。南院大王耶律斜軫善用欺敵之策，取希達青幟誘宋軍深入；韓德讓、劉弘與耶律學古同城死守，學古掘地道潛入城內，並擊退夜登城的三百餘名宋兵。迪里都都指揮使李扎勒燦出城投降，使城內軍心更為動搖，而遼主事後責問諸將不用兵法、遇敵即敗，休哥之請援正出於此種壓力之下。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities of the two camps. At the centre of the Song side stood Emperor Taizong of Song, Zhao Guangyi, who had destroyed the Northern Han in the fifth month of Taiping Xingguo and marched north without first reorganising his army. Before the expedition the only official to speak openly in favour of it was Cui Han, the deputy commander of the Palace Command who had come from Duan prefecture; the military affairs commissioner Cao Bin was then ordered to mobilise the troops. At the southeast corner of the city, while Cao Han's men were encamped, soldiers digging for a crab found one, and Cao Han observed that a crab is a water creature that has come to live on land, that it has many legs, and that the enemy is about to arrive; and he added that 'crab' also means to dissolve or withdraw, so the army is about to go home. This was the earliest warning of the defeat. Zhao Yanpu, chief of the horse and foot divisions, interceded when members of the imperial entourage failed to arrive on time and prevented the emperor from executing the stragglers under military law, which preserved the main body of the army. Fu Qian and Kong Shouzheng engaged the Liao first at Shahe and defeated the troops of the King of the Northern Court Yelü Xida, the commander Huituo Gu and Prince Saha, taking more than five hundred Liao soldiers alive. The most consequential figure on the Liao side was the King of the Northern Court Yelü Xiuge, who volunteered to go to the relief of Youzhou and marched at the head of the Five Guards; he was wounded three times yet fought on, and, his wounds too grave for riding, followed the Song in a light cart as far as Zhuozhou. The Vice King of the Southern Court Yelü Xiazhen was skilled at deception, taking the blue banners of the defeated Yelü Xida in order to draw the Song into a trap; Han Derang, Liu Hong and Yelü Xuegu held the city together with him, Xuegu digging a tunnel into the town and driving back a Song party of more than three hundred who tried to scale the walls by night. The commander of the Dali guard Li Zhalacan came out of the city and surrendered, which unsettled the defenders still further, and the Liao emperor afterwards upbraided his generals for failing to keep a watch and for fighting badly, meeting every foe with defeat; Xiuge's request to go to the relief was made in the face of exactly that sort of pressure.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是羅馬弩砲（Scorpio），前五十年已見於羅馬軍隊：它是扭力弩砲，以成束的獸筋或人髮扭成簧束儲能，一次只發一具粗壯的箭，能在遠距離擊穿甲冑，羅馬人用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。技術上，弩砲是配重式投石機的祖型：先有扭力蓄能的野驢式拋石機，後有把槓桿、吊索與配重結合的配重式投石機；而中國在同一時期的拋射兵器，核心恰恰是弓弩的扭力蓄能——弩機以角弓筋弦儲力，配合蹶張機張弦，步弩、踏張弩與張力極強的神臂弓構成宋軍的骨幹火力。中原弩機與羅馬弩砲共享同一條扭力技術譜系，兩端在絲路上的相互影響亦有學者提出。就高梁河一役而言，戰場上當然沒有羅馬弩砲，但它在技術譜系上的直系後裔，正是宋軍攻城所倚重的器械：幽州城牆周長約十六公里，宋軍自六月二十三日兵臨城下至七月仍不能攻克，用盡搭木攻城塔、撞竿、穴地與飛石投石等手段，拋射機的形制在東亞正是從弓弩的蓄能邁向配重。弩砲在這場戰爭裡的位置，只能是譜系上的祖先與對照：它說明宋遼之戰用過的每一具弩、每一座霹靂車，往上追溯都是羅馬扭力弩砲那一類蓄能技術的東土後裔。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman Scorpio, a torsion-powered bolt-thrower already in Roman service by 50 BC. It stored its energy in a bundle of twisted animal sinew or human hair, loosed one heavy bolt at a time, and could punch through armour at long range; the Romans used it to break Greek walls and in the end to break the Greek system of city-states. Technologically the scorpio is the ancestor of the counterweight trebuchet: first came the torsion-powered onager, and then the combination of a beam, a sling and a counterweight in the trebuchet, while the projectile machines of China in the same age were built on precisely the same torsion principle. The Chinese crossbow mechanism stored force in a horn bow and a sinew string and was drawn by a cranking device, and the foot crossbows, the tread-mounted crossbows and the immensely powerful divine-arm bows formed the backbone of Song firepower. The Chinese crossbow and the Roman scorpio share one torsion technological lineage, and their mutual influence at the two ends of the Silk Road has been argued by scholars. As for the Battle of Gaoliang River itself, no Roman scorpio was of course on the field, but its direct descendants in that lineage were exactly the machines the Song relied on in the siege: the walls of Youzhou were about 16 km in circuit, and from the twenty-third day of the sixth month, when the army reached the city, until the seventh month the Song failed to take it, employing plank-built siege towers, battering rams, tunnels and stone-throwing engines fed by counterweight. In the East Asian line the projectile machine had moved from the stored energy of the crossbow to the counterweight. Within this battle the scorpio can only occupy the place of an ancestor and a point of comparison: it shows that every crossbow and every thunder-crash trebuchet the Song and the Liao used in the north can be traced back to the same energy-storage technology as the Roman torsion catapult.
tactics: 宋軍的戰術失誤集中在圍城部署。兵書講圍三缺一、網開一面，宋太宗卻下令圍城三匝，四面合圍，使幽州守軍沒有活路而拚死抵抗；同時全部兵力投入攻城，等於放棄外線偵察與阻援，反使後到的遼軍援兵毫無阻礙地直抵城下。御駕行營原駐城南寶光寺，身後是安全的退卻方向，攻城前卻移駐城北曠野，把皇帝置於援軍南下的最前線；一旦兵敗，往南撤退還被幽州城阻隔。攻城四面各配主將：宋渥在南、崔彥進在北、劉遇在東、孟元喆在西，號令分散而火力不集中，士卒掘土怠於進攻，士氣日耗。遼軍的戰術是多層次包抄：斜軫以青幟換旗誘敵，德勝口屯兵八十里外按兵不動，任由宋軍消耗；耶律學古掘地道潛入城內，使宋軍圍城三匝的反制手段失效；七月初六高梁河畔，耶律沙部先與宋軍交鋒而敗退，宋軍乘勝追擊，薄暮時耶律休哥自間道馳至，人持兩炬，宋軍不測其多寡而生懼色；休哥與斜軫合軍分左右翼奮擊，學古開城列陣、四面鳴鼓，宋軍三面受敵全線潰潰。太宗負箭乘驢車南走，休哥創甚不能騎，改乘輕車追到涿州才止。一個是宋軍犯下的兵家大忌，一個是遼軍用火把製造全軍潰亂的奇襲，兩面合力決定了高梁河的結局。
tacticsEn: The Song tactical errors were concentrated in the deployment of the siege. Military manuals prescribe surrounding three sides and leaving one open, so that the besieged have a way out; the emperor instead ordered the city to be encircled on three circuits, a complete investiture on all four sides, which left the defenders of Youzhou no road to life and made them fight to the death. At the same time the whole army was committed to the siege, so no troops were left for reconnaissance outside the ring or to bar the approach of relief, and as a result the Liao reinforcements that came later met no obstacle at all on their march to the city. The imperial camp had originally stood at the Baoguang Temple south of the city, with the safe direction of withdrawal behind it; before the siege began it was moved to open ground north of the walls, placing the emperor on the foremost line of the relieving army's advance, and once the battle was lost the route south was blocked by the city itself. Each face of the attack had its own commander: Song Wo in the south, Cui Yanjin in the north, Liu Yu in the east and Meng Yuanzhe in the west, so orders were dispersed and firepower was not concentrated, and the soldiers, listless, dug in the ground rather than press the attack, with morale draining away by the day. The Liao tactic was a pincer in layers: Xiazhen used the exchanged banners to bait the enemy, and the troops at Deshengkou eighty li away sat still, letting the Song wear themselves out; Yelü Xuegu dug a tunnel into the city, which defeated the counter to the Song complete investiture; and on the sixth day of the seventh month at the Gaoliang River, after Yelü Sha's men had first been beaten back and the Song had pursued them, Yelü Xiuge came up by a side road at dusk, every man carrying two torches, and the Song, unable to judge how many there were, took fright; Xiuge and Xiazhen joined forces and attacked with the left and right wings, while Xuegu opened the gates, deployed the garrison and beat drums on all sides, and the Song, attacked from three quarters, collapsed along the whole line. The emperor, carrying an arrow wound, fled south on a donkey cart; Xiuge, whose wounds were too grave to ride, followed in a light cart and stopped only at Zhuozhou. On one side a cardinal military sin committed by the Song, on the other a surprise attack that used torches to unhinge an entire army, together decided the outcome at the Gaoliang River.
data: 可核的數字集中在兵力與戰果兩端。宋軍方面，京營禁軍（殿前司諸班、侍衛司馬步軍）約十萬，駐邊禁軍與河南、河北兵儲約十萬，合計二十萬，記錄作集結大軍三十萬；北漢既平，得州十、縣四十一、戶三萬五千二百二十、兵三萬，軍中久疲而求賞。遼軍方面，耶律休哥部約三萬，耶律斜軫部萬餘，幽州守軍六、七萬，援軍總數仍不及宋軍的一半。戰程上，沙河阻擊中生擒遼軍五百餘人，得勝口之戰斬首千餘級；幽州城牆周長約十六公里，自六月二十三日兵臨城下至七月圍城不下，攻城逾三月而未克，士卒掘土得蟹正出於此時；遼軍援軍初至時屯兵清沙河北岸，距城約八十里。決戰夜，耶律休哥身中三創而不能騎，輕車追至涿州，遼軍繳獲兵仗、符印、糧饋、貨幣不可勝計。地理上，戰場在今北京西直門外高梁河畔，遼軍追擊線由幽州城北直抵涿州方向，而宋軍退路須繞城而走，倉促之間失卻了整齊的隊形。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster at the two ends of the battle, the strengths deployed and the results gained. On the Song side, the capital garrison, the picked companies of the Palace Command and the foot and horse troops of the Guard Command, numbered about 100,000, and the frontier guards together with the troops and stores of Henan and Hebei supplied about another 100,000, making 200,000 in all, while the records describe an assembled army of 300,000; after the fall of the Northern Han the Song had taken ten prefectures, one army and forty-one counties, with 35,200 households and 30,000 men, and the troops were exhausted yet hungering for reward. On the Liao side, Yelü Xiuge had about 30,000 men, Yelü Xiazhen more than 10,000, and the garrison of Youzhou 60,000 to 70,000, so the relief force was still less than half the Song host. Along the course of the campaign, the blocking action at Shahe took more than five hundred Liao soldiers alive and the fight at Deshengkou cost the Liao over a thousand heads; the walls of Youzhou were about 16 km in circuit, and from the twenty-third day of the sixth month, when the Song reached the city, until the seventh month the siege ran for more than three months without success, which is exactly when the soldiers dug up a crab in the ground. When the Liao relief first arrived it sat on the north bank of the Qingsha River, some eighty li from the city. On the night of the decisive action Yelü Xiuge was wounded three times and could no longer ride, following in a light cart as far as Zhuozhou, and the Liao captured arms, seals, provisions and money beyond counting. Geographically the field lay along the Gaoliang River just outside Xizhimen in present-day Beijing, the line of Liao pursuit ran from north of Youzhou straight towards Zhuozhou, and the Song retreat had to skirt the city, so the army lost its order in the confusion of the withdrawal.
cause: 打起這場戰爭的直接起因，是燕雲十六州仍未收復。這十六州由後晉高祖石敬瑭割與契丹，成為遼南下中原的通道；宋太祖終其一生未能取回，太宗平定北漢後認為時機已到，決心乘勝一舉收復燕雲。促使他下定決心的，是滅北漢之戰中遼軍屢戰屢敗所透出的虛弱感，也是北漢新降、可以直接改編的行政與人口資源；但北漢剛平，宋軍主力未經整頓，將士普遍期待封賞而不願再戰，朝廷內部無人敢反對，只有崔翰公開進言乘此破竹之勢、取之甚易、時不可失也。遠征一旦啟動，前線的戰略判斷隨即失準：太宗把遼軍主力估得過低，認定幽州指日可下，於是提前任命潘美為幽州知府，把攻城與受援兩件事一併押上。遼方的反應則倉促而有效：此前白馬嶺慘敗後遼軍準備不足，北伐一開始才匆忙發兵，一旦判明宋軍直趨幽州，便令耶律休哥率五院軍入援，扭轉了戰局。歸根究柢，這是一場以政治目標壓過軍事準備的戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate occasion for the war was that the Sixteen Prefectures were still not recovered. They had been ceded by Shi Jingtang, founder of the Later Jin, to the Khitans, and formed the corridor by which Liao reached the Central Plain; Song Taizu failed to take them back in his lifetime, and after pacifying the Northern Han Taizong judged that the moment had come and resolved to recover Yan and Yun in one stroke. What persuaded him was the impression of Liao weakness left by the repeated Liao defeats in the campaign against the Northern Han, together with the administrative and human resources of the newly surrendered Northern Han, ready to be reassigned. But the Northern Han had only just fallen, the main body of the Song army had not been reorganised, and the soldiers in general expected their rewards and had no wish to fight on; nobody in the court dared to object, and only Cui Han spoke out in favour, saying that the momentum was like a bamboo splitting and the time must not be missed. Once the expedition was under way, tactical judgement at the front immediately went wrong: the emperor estimated the Liao main force far too low, assumed Youzhou would fall within days, and accordingly appointed Pan Mei as governor of Youzhou in advance, staking both the siege and the defence against relief on the same throw. The Liao response was hasty but effective: after the disaster at Baimaling they had not prepared, and only raised troops in confusion when the northern expedition began, but as soon as it was clear that the Song were driving straight at Youzhou they sent Yelü Xiuge with the Five Guards to the relief, and the situation turned. In the end this was a war in which political aims were allowed to override military preparation.
impact: 高梁河之敗是宋朝建國以來第一次在進攻戰中承受大敗。此役之前，禁軍在後周世宗與宋太祖兩朝手上久經鍛鍊，號稱精銳，滅北漢時勢如破竹；此役之後，宋軍在士氣、裝備與指揮三方面同時受創，北伐燕雲的戰略主動權自此轉到遼國一方。戰敗的直接後果是燕雲仍歸於遼，幽州得而復失，北宋此後再未集主力北伐，只在邊境做局部爭奪。兩個月後遼軍主動南下，雙方在滿城再戰，宋軍才以硬仗打出一場勝利，但整體格局仍未改變，宋遼進入長期相持，而這條邊界終究要等到二十五年後的澶淵之盟才以和議方式固定下來。高梁河還留下兩個長期的教訓：其一，御駕親征時行營位置與退路設計決定君主的人身風險，太宗身上帶走的箭傷，使宋廷此後對君主涉險多了一層顧慮；其二，遼廷在危局中提拔耶律休哥這類能戰之名將，使遼的中興格局提前出現，而蕭太后在此次危機中的處置，讓她在此後二十年的執政中聲望不減。從技術史的角度看，這一役留下的另一份遺產是攻城術的轉向：宋軍在幽州城牆前證明了純粹圍城消耗的無效，此後中原對北方城防更倚重城垣體系與北方騎兵的反制。卡面這具羅馬弩砲所代表的扭力拋射技術譜系，則在宋遼之後隨戰爭與交流繼續東傳與改變。
impactEn: The defeat at Gaoliang River was the first major reverse the Song suffered in an offensive war since the dynasty's founding. Before it, the imperial guards, hammered into shape under the reigns of Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou and Emperor Taizu of Song, had a reputation for strength and had broken the Northern Han with irresistible momentum; after it, the Song army was wounded at once in morale, equipment and command, and the strategic initiative in the northern campaign passed to the Liao. The immediate consequence was that Yan and Yun remained Liao territory and Youzhou was lost as well as besieged; the Northern Song never again concentrated its main army for a northern expedition and henceforth fought only local actions along the frontier. Two months later the Liao marched south of its own accord and the two sides met again at Mancheng, where the Song at last won a hard-fought battle, yet the overall pattern was unchanged and the two states entered a long stalemate, a frontier that would only be fixed by treaty twenty-five years later in the Chanyuan alliance. The Gaoliang River also left two long-term lessons. First, when the emperor led in person, the siting of the imperial camp and the design of the line of retreat determined the physical risk run by the sovereign; the arrow wound the emperor carried away from the field made the Song court add another layer of caution thereafter about exposing its ruler. Second, the Liao court in a moment of danger promoted a general of demonstrated ability such as Yelü Xiuge, so that the Liao revival took shape earlier than it might otherwise have, and the way the empress dowager handled this crisis preserved her authority through the twenty years of her regency that followed. From the point of view of the history of technology, the battle left a second inheritance, a turning in siegecraft: the Song army proved before the walls of Youzhou the uselessness of pure siege attrition, and from then on the Central Plain relied more heavily on the wall-and-tower system of fortification and on countermeasures against northern cavalry. The line of torsion projectile technology represented by the Roman scorpio on the card continued to travel east and to be altered in the wars and exchanges that followed the Song-Liao conflict.
result: 結果是遼軍大勝、宋軍全盤撤退。七月的高梁河之戰中，耶律沙部先敗、耶律休哥與耶律斜軫合擊、耶律學古開城列陣，宋軍三面被圍而崩潰，太宗負箭乘驢車南走，遼軍追到涿州才停止，繳獲的兵仗、符印、糧餉與錢貨不可勝計。太平興國四年第一次北伐的部署至此全部作廢，幽州沒有攻下，河北新取的易州、涿州等地也隨大軍退走，宋太宗回到太原再還京師，北伐的目標燕雲十六州一州未得。軍心方面，滅北漢時未兌現的封賞成為怨言的來源，加以主力折損、攻城器械盡失，宋廷不得不重新檢視禁軍整頓與糧餉籌措。對遼而言，此役除守住南京與燕雲外，還贏得數年的戰略主動：耶律休哥自請赴援、負創不退，遼主由是倚之為大將，蕭太后也藉此役穩住剛即位的幼主與朝局。兩個月後遼軍南下攻宋，滿城之役宋軍將士在前敗後怯的情況下竟然得勝，說明宋軍戰力並未因高梁河而喪盡，只是需要時間與整頓。總結而言：宋軍攻勢全線失敗，遼軍防守成功並反守為攻，燕雲屏障依舊牢固，高梁河畔的這場敗仗，成為北宋前期軍事史上最重要的分水嶺。
resultEn: The result was a decisive Liao victory and a complete withdrawal of the Song army. In the fighting at the Gaoliang River in the seventh month, Yelü Sha's men were beaten first, Yelü Xiuge and Yelü Xiazhen attacked together, and Yelü Xuegu opened the gates and deployed the garrison, and the Song, attacked from three quarters, collapsed; the emperor, carrying an arrow wound, fled south on a donkey cart, and the Liao pursued as far as Zhuozhou before stopping, capturing arms, seals, provisions and money beyond counting. The whole deployment of the first northern expedition of the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo was thereby wasted: Youzhou was not taken, the newly seized prefectures in Hebei such as Yizhou and Zhuozhou were abandoned as the army withdrew, and the emperor returned first to Taiyuan and then to the capital, not one of the Sixteen Prefectures that had been the object of the campaign gained. In the army, the rewards promised after the conquest of the Northern Han and never paid became a source of resentment, and with the main body shattered and the siege equipment lost, the Song court had to reconsider the training of the guards and the organisation of supply. For the Liao, besides keeping the Southern Capital and Yan and Yun, the battle bought years of strategic initiative: Yelü Xiuge had volunteered for the relief and pressed on despite his wounds, and the Liao ruler accordingly relied on him as a general, while the empress dowager used the occasion to steady the newly enthroned boy emperor and the court. Two months later the Liao marched south against the Song, and at Mancheng the Song, in the shadow of a recent defeat and a general faltering of spirit, actually won, which shows that the fighting capacity of the Song army was not exhausted by the Gaoliang River but merely in need of time and reform. In sum: the Song offensive failed on every front, the Liao defence succeeded and turned into a counter-offensive, the Yan-Yun barrier remained as firm as ever, and the defeat on the banks of the Gaoliang River became the single most important watershed in the military history of the early Northern Song.
